title: The China–Europe rail corridor: 11,000 km without a ship
description: From Chongqing to Duisburg, overland across six countries

source.name: Natural Earth; UTLC / DB Cargo corridor maps

insight: One overland corridor, 11,000 km, 12–16 days — independent of the maritime chokepoints.

territories.note: Kazakhstan carries the longest single stretch of the corridor — the trains run its full width from the Alashankou border.
At Brest, on the Polish frontier, every train changes gauge from the wide Russian 1,520 mm to Europe's 1,435 mm.
Duisburg's inland port on the Rhine has become the western anchor of the whole corridor.
